findings.issue: The worked expected-value line changes the first value from 0 to 7, creating an unsupported term and an arithmetic contradiction.
findings.evidence: CURRENT has E(X) = 0(0.5) + 1(0.3) + 2(0.15) + 3(0.05) = 0.75. PROPOSED instead begins with 7(0.5) but still claims the products are 0 + 0.3 + 0.3 + 0.15 = 0.75. As written, 7(0.5) + 1(0.3) + 2(0.15) + 3(0.05) = 4.25, not 0.75.
